column1: # Purpose: `./dev bench classify` reports 40/40 on tests/eval/corpus.yaml — but
# the classifier rules were tuned against that same corpus, so it measures fit,
# not generalization. This file is an INDEPENDENT held-out slice: ~30 well-known
# live sites that are NOT in tests/eval/corpus.yaml and NOT in
# tests/optimization/sites.tsv, labelled by inspection of the real fetch.
# Output reports the per-class confusion matrix + accuracy (live, point-in-time).
# Labelling rule: ground truth is judged from whether the main content is present
# in the HTTP response (extractable → static/ssr/hydrated) or genuinely absent
# (needs a browser → spa/dynamic, or a bot wall → blocked). App sites are labelled
# by their MARKETING HOMEPAGE (server-rendered), not the in-app SPA.
